criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Seeking Medical Information
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information about symptoms, treatments, prevention, or transmission of COVID-19.

categories.name: Expressing Gratitude
categories.definition: Utterances expressing thanks or appreciation for help or information related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Donating to COVID-19 Relief
categories.definition: Utterances expressing intent to donate money or resources to support COVID-19 medical research, hospitals, or charities.

categories.name: Seeking Travel Advice
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information about travel restrictions, safety, or guidelines related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: Utterances related to myths, misinformation, or misconceptions about COVID-19.

categories.name: Animal and Pet Concerns
categories.definition: Utterances related to concerns about pets, animals, or wildlife in relation to COVID-19.

categories.name: Environmental Concerns
categories.definition: Utterances related to concerns about surfaces, objects, or environments potentially contaminated with COVID-19.

categories.name: Community Support and Donations
categories.definition: Utterances expressing intent to donate or support local communities, hospitals, schools, or food banks affected by COVID-19.

categories.name: Government Updates and Policies
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information about government actions, policies, or updates related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Personal Protection and Hygiene
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information about personal protective measures, hygiene practices, or cleaning routines to prevent COVID-19.

categories.name: Social Distancing and Isolation
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information about social distancing guidelines, isolation protocols, or high-risk areas for COVID-19.

categories.name: Vaccine Development and Treatment
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information about vaccine development, treatment options, or clinical trials for COVID-19.
